visual_goal: Show sources landing raw in bronze, conformed in silver, certified in gold only after the ledger tie-out passes, and consumers reading through the governed metrics layer.
prompt: A left-to-right data-flow illustration. At the far left, a stack of mixed database cylinders and document files labeled once 'Sources'. Next, three pipes merging into one, labeled 'Ingestion', with one arrow from 'Sources'. Next, a tall warehouse block with three stacked shelves coloured bronze, silver and gold from bottom to top: the bottom bronze shelf labeled 'Bronze' holding sealed raw crates, the middle silver shelf labeled 'Silver' holding neatly sorted boxes, the top gold shelf labeled 'Gold' holding boxes with green certification seals. One arrow from 'Ingestion' into 'Bronze', one arrow up from 'Bronze' to 'Silver'. Between the silver shelf and the gold shelf, and only there, a checkpoint gate with a balance-scale icon; the label 'Tie-out' is written directly on this gate. The arrow from 'Silver' passes up through the gate into 'Gold'. The arrow from 'Bronze' up to 'Silver' is plain and unlabeled. From the top gold shelf 'Gold', at the very top of the warehouse, one arrow leaves to the right and goes down into a clean panel labeled 'Metrics layer'; this arrow starts at the gold shelf and nowhere else. At the far right, a group of three unlabeled icons, a chart screen, a robot head and a planning calendar, labeled once 'Consumers', receiving one arrow from 'Metrics layer'.
alt: Sources flow through ingestion into bronze raw storage, are conformed in silver, pass a ledger tie-out gate into certified gold, and reach consumers only through the governed metrics layer.

visual_goal: Show the daily tie-out comparing the ledger to the warehouse copy, sending unexplained differences to the source owner for a fix at source, and certifying only on agreement.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. At the far left, two stacked elements: on top a database cylinder labeled 'FinDB'; below it, near the bottom left, an open book labeled 'Ledgers'. Each sends one arrow into a large balance scale in the centre labeled 'Tie-out'. From the scale, two paths leave to the right. The upper path is green, marked with a green tick labeled 'agreement', and ends at a document with a gold certification seal labeled 'Certified' at the top right. The lower path is red, marked with a warning triangle labeled 'difference', and ends at a desk at the bottom right labeled 'Source owner'. From the 'Source owner' desk, one single red arrow runs straight left along the bottom of the canvas and ends pointing into the open book 'Ledgers' at the bottom left, labeled 'fix at source'. Exactly five arrows; the 'FinDB' cylinder has only its one arrow into the scale.
alt: Ledger balances and FinDB balances meet at a tie-out scale; agreement leads to certification, while a difference goes to the source owner, who fixes it at the source.

visual_goal: Show a number's status moving one way with the close, from operational to closed, with restatement as the only recorded route to change a closed number.
prompt: A state map drawn as rounded stepping stones on a one-way path from left to right, with a single direction arrow painted on the path: 'Operational', 'Preliminary', 'Flash', 'Closed'. One arrow from 'Operational' to 'Preliminary', one from 'Preliminary' to 'Flash' with a small tag 'WD3', and one from 'Flash' to 'Closed' with a small tag 'WD9'. A second arrow arcs over 'Flash' from 'Preliminary' directly to 'Closed'. 'Closed' is drawn as a stone with a padlock. To the right of 'Closed', a stone with an official stamp and a ledger page labeled 'Restated', with one arrow from 'Closed' into it and one arrow back from it into 'Closed'. Exactly six arrows.
alt: Status stones from Operational through Preliminary and Flash to a padlocked Closed, with a bypass from Preliminary to Closed and a recorded Restated loop as the only way to change a closed number.

visual_goal: Show the end-to-end lineage of the €90 commission from the stay-completion event to the board pack, with the metric version and tie-out record making the path auditable.
prompt: A left-to-right chain illustration like a string of linked beads, each a small box joined to the next by one arrow: at the far left a lightning-bolt box labeled 'StayCompleted', then 'Subledger line', then a key icon labeled 'summary_id', then 'Daily journal', then an open book labeled 'Trial balance', then a padlocked stack labeled 'Consolidation', then at the far right a presentation board labeled 'Board pack' showing the large figure '€90'. A small coin labeled '€90' rides on the chain near the start. Above the chain, near the right end, a version tag labeled 'net_revenue v3' hanging from the board pack. Below 'Consolidation', a small certificate labeled 'tie-out: zero difference' joined by a short line. A magnifying glass hovers over the chain, tracing it back from the board pack.
alt: A chain from the StayCompleted event through the subledger line, summary_id key, daily journal, trial balance and locked consolidation to the board pack showing €90, with a metric version tag and a zero-difference tie-out record.
